reader_summary.headline: My guest today is Niraj Shah, the CEO and co-founder of Wayfair.
reader_summary.overview: My guest today is Niraj Shah, the CEO and co-founder of Wayfair. Wayfair started life in 2002 as a collection of independent websites selling category-specific home furniture but became a one-stop-shop for the home category in 2011 when. Today, the business offers 22 million products from 16 thousand suppliers to more than 30 million customers.
